title: Agentic SE course progress export
description: A learner's progress file, downloaded from the course site and sent to the course owner. Version 1.

schema.description: Fixed identifier of this file type.

schemaVersion.description: Integer schema version. Bumped only for breaking changes.

exportedAt.description: When the file was exported (ISO 8601, UTC).

appVersion.description: Build of the site that wrote the file, for example mockup-2026-10.

userAgentFamily.description: Coarse browser family only; never the full user agent string.

learner.description: Who the file belongs to. Contains no name or email unless the learner typed one as an alias.

id.description: Random identifier created in the browser on first use. Used to de-duplicate files from the same learner.

alias.description: Optional label chosen by the learner. Empty if not set.

cohort.description: Course run the learner belongs to. Set to the cohort name of a loaded cohort calendar (see calendar.schema.json); the calendar itself is not exported.

createdAt.description: When the local record was first created.

items.description: Pre-work and activity items, keyed by w{week}:{itemId}, for example w1:pw-3.

doneAt.description: When the item was marked done. Absent unless status is done.

minutesSpent.description: Self-reported minutes the item took. Optional.

estimateMinutes.description: The page's time estimate for the item when it was marked. Compared with minutesSpent to calibrate budgets.

track.description: Track the learner was on when the item was marked.

additionalProperties.description: All attempts for that week, oldest first.

estimates.description: Week 0 benchmark activity: the learner's effort estimates for reference tasks, one per task.

taskId.description: Identifier of the benchmark task (matches an id in benchmarks.json).

estimateMinutes.description: The learner's estimate of the human minutes the task needs.

specQuality.description: Perceived quality of the task specification, 1 (vague) to 5 (precise).

pairId.description: Identifier linking two estimates of paired tasks, if the activity pairs them.

revealedAt.description: When the learner saw the ground truth. The estimate is locked from then on.

deliverables.description: Weekly deliverable records, keyed by w{week}.

url.description: Link to the learner's deliverable (repository, gist, document).

submittedAt.description: When the record was last saved.

rubricSelf.description: Self-assessment against the rubric: row id mapped to a level.

events.description: Compact append-only log of actions, capped at the latest 500, for timing analysis.

type.description: Action kind, for example item:done, quiz:submit, estimate:add.

ref.description: What the action referred to, for example w1:pw-3.

outcomes.description: Optional. The learner's 'I can do this' ticks on each week's outcomes checklist, keyed by w{week} and then by outcome id. Added without a version change; readers that do not know the field ignore it.

additionalProperties.description: Outcome id (for example o1) mapped to its latest state.

checked.description: True while the learner ticks the outcome. An unticked outcome is kept with false so that a merge can tell which side is newer.

at.description: When the box was last changed. The later value wins when two files are merged.

stageLogs.description: Optional. The learner's stage logs: the Week 3 hand-run loop and the Week 5 per-change report, keyed by w{week}. Each value lists entries in the order they were logged. Added without a version change.

additionalProperties.description: Stage log entries for that week.

certificates.description: Optional. Course completion certificates and badges saved by the learner, keyed by w{week}:{courseId}, for example w1:claude-code-101. Added without a version change.

course.description: Name of the course, for example 'Claude Code 101'.

platform.description: Platform or issuer, for example 'Claude Academy' or 'OpenAI Academy'.

url.description: HTTPS credential or badge link, or null.

image.description: Screenshot of the badge as a JPEG data URL, or null.

earnedOn.description: When the certificate was earned (YYYY-MM-DD), or null.

addedAt.description: When the certificate entry was saved locally (ISO 8601, UTC). Used to resolve conflicts when merging.

attempt.description: One run through a week's self-check.

attemptId.description: Random identifier of the attempt; used to merge files without duplicates.

submittedAt.description: When the attempt was submitted. Null if abandoned.

qid.description: Question identifier within the week, for example q2.

response.description: Zero-based choice index for mcq, free text for short.

correct.description: mcq only: whether the choice matched the page's answer key.

selfScore.description: short only: learner's score after reveal (0 missed, 1 partly, 2 matched).

confidence.description: Confidence recorded before the answer was revealed, 1 (guess) to 4 (certain).

revealedAt.description: When the learner opened the answer.

autoMax.description: Number of mcq questions in the key.

selfMax.description: Maximum possible self-score (2 per short question).

stageLogEntry.description: One stage of one change: what the human spent, what the agent cost, what context it was given and where a person had to step in.

id.description: Random identifier of the entry. Merges match on it and keep the entry with the later 'at'.

change.description: Label of the issue or change the stage belongs to, for example 'issue 4'.

stage.description: Which stage of the loop this entry records.

humanMinutes.description: Minutes of human attention spent in this stage. Null if not recorded.

tokens.description: Tokens the agent used in this stage, as reported by the tool. Null if not recorded or cleared by the learner.

costUsd.description: Cost of the stage in US dollars, as reported by the tool. Null if not recorded or cleared by the learner.

contextGiven.description: Free text: what context the agent was given (files, spec, rules).

intervention.description: Free text: what the human had to correct or redirect. Empty if nothing.

cause.description: Why an intervention was needed: the agent lacked context, chose the wrong design, or differed on taste. 'none' means no intervention; null means not classified.

judgement.description: Free text: the human judgement this stage needed, in the learner's words.

failed.description: Optional. True when this stage was a failed run (the agent run did not produce a usable result). Its minutes and cost still count in the totals. Absent means false; entries written before this field existed stay valid.

at.description: When the entry was last saved. The later value wins when two files are merged.
